= Frequently Asked Questions =

==Installation==
===I have a 64 bit machine, what should I do?===
If you have 64 bit operating system installed on your 64 bit machine, you will not be able to run this program. Because
 # Our binary packages are not compatible with your OS.
 # PyQt4 library we use is not compatible with 64 bit yet.

If you can install a 32-bit OS on your machine, you will be able to run this software.
